source_title: Geostrophic transport of the South Equatorial Current in the Atlantic
author: Lothar Stramma
abstract_access: Repository abstract actually read via web tool on review date.
full_text_access: Repository Download link followed once; web fetch returned HTTP403. Full paper not acquired or read.
source_facts: Abstract cautiously proposes Atlantic SECC eastward extent across the basin to at least Greenwich; it does not provide an alongflow distance or an explicit observed axis.
Abstract distinguishes the South Equatorial Undercurrent from SECC.
The abstract says its geostrophic data do not establish seasonality.
osw_decision: Retain as a longitudinal-extent source lead. Do not join historical sections into an axis or calculate a whole-current length from unsynchronized observations.
next_action: Seek a legitimately accessible full primary study with alongflow geometry and named-current continuity; no repeat of the denied download in this stage.
